uzo.purpose: Offers actions for one object behind a single button: edit, duplicate, delete; an entry may carry an icon (attribute icon) and name its group (attribute group); an entry with a target (attribute to) is a link to it, because it moves the person (Regulo link-navigates-button-acts).

instead.kialo: A menu that leads to pages is a navigation, because an action menu fires actions on one object and a navigation moves a person through the application (G6: Menü alone is the navigado's word).
A menu whose entries are values of one field is a select, because the choice stays as the field's value and is sent with the form; a menu entry fires once and holds nothing.
A menu with one entry hides an action behind a click, because a person opens it only to find one command; one action is a button with its name.

boundary.kialo: A menu that opens a second menu beside an entry is not supported, because it needs a pointer path and a second focus path a keyboard cannot follow; group the entries with a separator or split them over two menus.

An entry that stays checked is a setting, not an action, because it holds a state after the menu closed; a person decides whether it is a switch beside the object or a menu of checkable items (role menuitemcheckbox) in a later step.

containers.name: record-header
containers.kialo: The actions on one record stand in its head, because the head names the object the actions act on.

with.kialo: The actions on one row of a table are a menu behind one button in the row, because a button per action would fill the row with controls; the tabelo sends its row actions here.
The trigger of a menu is a button, because a menu opens on a command; with an icon alone it carries the name of the menu as its label (icon-meaning-named).
An entry may carry an icon before its word, because the sign is read faster than the word — and never alone, the word names the action.
Groups of entries are separated by a line, because a line says that the entries above and below belong to different things (edit and duplicate; delete).

case.de: Die Einträge führen zu Seiten der Anwendung.
case.en: The entries lead to pages of the application.

case.de: Die Einträge sind Werte eines Felds, die mit dem Formular gesendet werden.
case.en: The entries are values of a field that are sent with the form.

case.de: Es gibt nur eine einzige Aktion.

do.de: Nenne in jedem Eintrag die Aktion als Verb und stelle gefährliche Aktionen ans Ende.
do.en: Name the action in every entry as a verb and put dangerous actions at the end.

do.de: Gib dem Menü mit label einen Namen; ohne ihn heißt es „Weitere Aktionen“.
do.en: Give the menu a name with label; without it, it is called “More actions”.

do.de: Trenne Gruppen von Einträgen mit einer Trennlinie oder group.
do.en: Separate groups of entries with a separator or group.

dont.de: Ein Untermenü an einen Eintrag hängen; teile die Einträge lieber auf zwei Menüs.
dont.en: Hang a submenu on an entry; split the entries over two menus instead.

dont.de: Einträge bauen, die nach dem Schließen angehakt bleiben, denn eine Einstellung ist keine Aktion.
dont.en: Build entries that stay ticked after closing, because a setting is no action.

action.de: Auf dem Auslöser öffnen die Tasten das Menü; im Menü wählen sie den Eintrag mit dem Fokus, und das Menü schließt sich.
action.en: On the trigger the keys open the menu; in the menu they choose the entry with the focus, and the menu closes.

action.de: Pfeil runter öffnet das Menü vom Auslöser aus; im Menü gehen die Tasten zum nächsten oder vorigen Eintrag, am Ende geht es von vorn weiter.
action.en: Arrow Down opens the menu from the trigger; in the menu the keys move to the next or previous entry, wrapping at the end.

action.de: Gehen zum ersten oder letzten Eintrag.
action.en: Move to the first or last entry.

action.de: Schließt das Menü; der Fokus kehrt zum Auslöser zurück.
action.en: Closes the menu; the focus returns to the trigger.

action.de: Getippte Buchstaben gehen zum Eintrag, der mit ihnen beginnt.
action.en: Typed letters move to the entry that starts with them.
